description.zh_CN: 临光与Ace是配合默契的战友。临光称呼Ace为"你"并主动感谢他的援助，而Ace则谦逊地推辞说自己"没资格让耀骑士还我人情"。两人在战场上互相掩护，临光更是在被浮士德狙击时感受到Ace的火力支援。
description.en_US: Nearl and Ace are trusted combat partners. Nearl addresses Ace directly, thanking him for his support while Ace humbly deflects credit, saying he isn't worthy of the Radiant Knight owing him favors.

quote.zh_CN: 谢谢你刚才的援助，临光不会忘记这份恩情。请别这么说。我可没资格让耀骑士还我人情。
quote.en_US: Thank you for your assistance just now, Nearl won't forget this kindness. Please don't say that. I'm not worthy of the Radiant Knight owing me favors.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 临光真诚感谢Ace的援助并表达铭记恩情，Ace谦逊地回应，体现了两人作为战友的默契与相互尊重
context_analysis.en_US: Nearl sincerely thanks Ace and expresses gratitude; Ace humbly responds, showing战友 trust and mutual respect

quote.zh_CN: 浮士德！把她那张嘴给我打穿。——不会让你得逞！
quote.en_US: Faust! Shoot that mouth shut. ——You won't get away with it!

context_analysis.zh_CN: Ace在浮士德狙击临光时挺身而出保护她，展现了战友间互相掩护的战斗默契
context_analysis.en_US: Ace shields Nearl when Faust狙击 her, demonstrating their battlefield trust and cooperation

description.zh_CN: 梅菲斯特对临光怀有强烈的毁灭欲。临光出现时梅菲斯特震惊其战斗力，随即命令浮士德"把她那张嘴给我打穿"并"再来！！把她......打成碎渣"，展现出病态的攻击性。临光则冷静地分析并蔑视梅菲斯特的指挥风格。
description.en_US: Mephisto harbors intense destructive urges toward Nearl. When Nearl appears, Mephisto is shocked by her combat prowess and immediately orders Faust to shoot her down, screaming "do it again! Turn her to pieces!" — revealing pathological aggression. Nearl calmly analyzes and despises Mephisto's command style.

quote.zh_CN: 我想和各位，来一场祭祀式的竞赛。
quote.en_US: I'd like to have a ritual competition with all of you.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 梅菲斯特将战斗比作"祭祀式的竞赛"，展现了对生命的漠视和病态的价值观
context_analysis.en_US: Mephisto compares battle to a "ritual competition", revealing his pathological disregard for life

quote.zh_CN: 把她那张嘴给我打穿。——再来！！把她......打成碎渣！
quote.en_US: Shoot that mouth shut. ——Do it again! Turn her... into pieces!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 梅菲斯特命令浮士德狙击临光，并狂躁地要求将她"打成碎渣"，揭示了对临光的强烈仇恨
context_analysis.en_US: Mephisto orders Faust to shoot Nearl and furiously demands to "turn her to pieces", revealing intense hatred

quote.zh_CN: 屠杀，纵火，围猎......只不过是为了满足你自己残忍的趣味而已吧？会在这时煽动如此不堪之事的人，没可能策划出足以击溃整座城市的方案。
quote.en_US: Massacre, arson, hunting... merely to satisfy your own cruel whims, right? Someone who incites such atrocities at this moment couldn't have planned to collapse an entire city.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 临光当面斥责梅菲斯特的暴行，分析其行为只是满足残忍趣味而非真正的战略家
context_analysis.en_US: Nearl directly condemns Mephisto's atrocities, analyzing his actions as mere cruel whims rather than true strategy

description.zh_CN: 杜宾与Ace是罗德岛的两位资深战士，在战场上配合默契。杜宾称呼Ace为"Ace！"并在危急时刻依赖他的判断，两人互相认可对方的能力。
description.en_US: Dobermann and Ace are Rhodes Island's two veteran warriors who cooperate seamlessly in battle. Dobermann calls out "Ace!" and relies on his judgment in critical moments, each recognizing the other's competence.

quote.zh_CN: Ace！这里还没到汇合点......怎么只有你一个人？
quote.en_US: Ace! We haven't reached the rendezvous point yet... why are you alone?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 杜宾见到Ace时急切呼唤并询问情况，展现了战友间的关切
context_analysis.en_US: Dobermann urgently calls out to Ace and asks about the situation, showing战友 concern

quote.zh_CN: Ace......稍等一下。
quote.en_US: Ace... wait a moment.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 杜宾主动让Ace稍等，说明她需要与Ace商量战术
context_analysis.en_US: Dobermann tells Ace to wait, indicating she needs to consult with him tactically

relation_label.zh_CN: 从质疑到信任的战场搭档
relation_label.en_US: From Skepticism to Trusted Battlefield Partner

description.zh_CN: 杜宾对博士的信任经历了从质疑到认可再到托付的过程。在第0章中，杜宾在战斗中向Ace解释"博士的指挥能力有没有因为失忆受到影响"，并最终表示"做得不错，Dr.{@nickname}，是该客观评价你的能力了"，完成了信任的建立。
description.en_US: Dobermann's trust in the Doctor evolved from skepticism to recognition to entrustment. In Ch00, she asks Ace "has the Doctor's command ability been affected by the amnesia?" and ultimately says "Well done, Dr.{@nickname}, it's time to objectively evaluate your abilities", completing the trust-building process.

quote.zh_CN: 做得不错，Dr.{@nickname}。是该客观评价你的能力了。
quote.en_US: Well done, Dr.{@nickname}. It's time to objectively evaluate your abilities.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 杜宾第一次在战斗后称赞博士能力，并表示要客观评价，说明她开始从质疑转向认可
context_analysis.en_US: Dobermann praises the Doctor's abilities for the first time after battle, indicating a shift from skepticism to recognition

quote.zh_CN: 博士的指挥能力，有没有因为失忆受到影响？
quote.en_US: Has the Doctor's command ability been affected by the amnesia?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 杜宾向Ace确认博士的能力，说明她仍在评估阶段，但已经主动为博士说话
context_analysis.en_US: Dobermann confirms the Doctor's abilities with Ace, showing she is still evaluating but already speaking up for him

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅与杜宾是上下级关系，但杜宾对阿米娅展现出超越命令的关心。当阿米娅决定信任博士时，杜宾提醒她"做好准备"。阿米娅也经常在危机时呼唤杜宾配合，两人建立了超越职位的战友信任。
description.en_US: Amiya and Dobermann have a commander-subordinate relationship, but Dobermann shows concern for Amiya beyond mere duty. When Amiya decides to trust the Doctor, Dobermann warns her to "be prepared". Amiya frequently calls on Dobermann in crisis, showing their bond transcends rank.

quote.zh_CN: Ace......事情和以前相比，有不小的区别。博士......意外失去了记忆。
quote.en_US: Ace... things are quite different from before. The Doctor... unexpectedly lost his memory.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅向Ace解释博士失忆的情况，展现了她作为指挥官的决策角色和对团队的信任
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya explains the Doctor's amnesia to Ace, showing her role as commander and trust in the team

quote.zh_CN: （阿米娅，准备好，我们可能要强行突围了。）
quote.en_US: (Amiya, be prepared, we may need to break through by force.)

context_analysis.zh_CN: 杜宾在战斗中对阿米娅耳语提醒要做好准备，展现了她对阿米娅的关照
context_analysis.en_US: Dobermann whispers to Amiya to be prepared for possible forced breakthrough, showing her care for Amiya

quote.zh_CN: 总有一天，你要和阿米娅一起共同面对这片残酷的大地。所以，保护好她，博士。

context_analysis.en_US: Talulah as Reunion's supreme leader commands Mephisto's operations

description.zh_CN: 上下级/特殊信任
description.en_US: Superior and subordinate / Special trust

quote.zh_CN: 浮士德和弑君者已经破坏了一处防御——这样就万无一失了。
quote.en_US: Faust and Patriot have destroyed a defense — this makes everything foolproof.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 塔露拉信任浮士德执行破坏防御任务
context_analysis.en_US: Talulah trusts Faust to execute the defense sabotage mission

relation_label.zh_CN: 领袖对干员的关怀/鼓励

description.zh_CN: 领袖对干员的关怀/鼓励
description.en_US: Leader's care for operators / Encouragement

quote.zh_CN: 站起来吧，杰西卡。你不用再害怕了——因为你现在，和我们在一起。你不孤单，你身边永远有我们。
quote.en_US: Stand up, Jessica. You don't have to be afraid anymore — because you're with us now. You're not alone, we're always here for you.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅鼓励害怕中的杰西卡站起来
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya encourages the frightened Jessica to stand up

relation_label.zh_CN: 表面政敌·实则青梅挚友

description.zh_CN: 陈与诗怀雅是童年挚友，曾一起玩耍，塔露拉也曾是她们的朋友。陈小时候性格刚烈、总是冲在最前保护大家，却从不肯向人求助；诗怀雅一直崇拜她、害怕她、又心疼她。长大后两人在龙门近卫局成为职场竞争对手，互相指责对方的决策，但私下诗怀雅对陈的安危极度关心，甚至在陈受伤时急切拿出消毒湿巾帮她处理伤口，星熊评价陈"心口不一"——嘴上强硬，内心柔软。这是一段极度复杂的青梅关系：竞争外表下藏着深厚信任，嘴上互不相让，行动却彼此牵挂。
description.en_US: Ch'en and Swire are childhood friends who once played together with Talulah. Young Ch'en was aggressive but always protected others without asking for help; Swire adored, feared, and pitied her. As adults they became workplace rivals in the Lungmen Guard Bureau, publicly criticizing each other — yet privately Swire panics over Ch'en's safety, rushing to treat her injuries with disinfectant wipes. Hoshiguma describes Ch'en as 'saying one thing, meaning another.' This is a deeply complex青梅 relationship: beneath fierce professional rivalry lies profound trust and mutual care.

relation_complexity.core_nature: 青梅挚友因职场竞争而互相指责，但内心深处彼此牵挂
tension_points: 陈擅自离开近卫局导致失守
诗怀雅担心陈会变成第二个塔露拉
两人对城市发展方向理念不同
bond_points: 陈小时候保护过诗怀雅
诗怀雅私下向星熊承认担心陈的安全
陈受伤时诗怀雅立刻拿出消毒湿巾

quote.zh_CN: 小时候我也和塔露拉一起玩过。虽然记不太清了，但我知道......我很喜欢和她做朋友。就算她又盛气凌人又坏脾气，但她会挡在我们身前来着。一句话也不说，一点也不懂撤退。什么事情都自己冲在第一位，从来不向我们寻求帮助......
quote.en_US: When I was little I played with Talulah too. I don't remember much anymore, but I know... I really liked being friends with her. Even though she was overbearing and bad-tempered, she'd stand in front of us to protect us. Never said a word, never knew when to retreat, always charged ahead first, never asked any of us for help...

context_analysis.zh_CN: 诗怀雅回忆童年与陈（和塔露拉）一起玩耍的情景：陈虽然脾气坏但会挡在朋友前面保护，从不求助——这解释了诗怀雅现在对陈复杂的情感：既敬畏又心疼。诗怀雅用'她'指代陈，说'很喜欢和她做朋友'，证实了青梅关系。
context_analysis.en_US: Swire reminisces about playing with Ch'en (and Talulah) as children: Ch'en was aggressive but would stand in front to protect them, never asked for help — explaining Swire's complex feelings: both revering and pitying Ch'en. 'I really liked being friends with her' confirms childhood bond.

quote.zh_CN: ......星熊，我很害怕，我害怕她......
quote.en_US: ...Hoshiguma, I'm scared, I'm scared of her...

context_analysis.zh_CN: 诗怀雅私下向星熊坦承她'害怕'陈——不是恐惧，而是担心陈会像塔露拉一样被黑暗吞噬。这是深藏的关心，而不是敌意。
context_analysis.en_US: Swire privately admits to Hoshiguma she's 'scared' of Ch'en — not terrified, but worried Ch'en will be consumed by darkness like Talulah. This is concealed concern, not hostility.

quote.zh_CN: 你受伤了？！......怎么会是小事！我这里有消毒湿巾，过来。......伤口不大，不过很深。好像......还有一点法术的痕迹。
quote.en_US: You're hurt?! ...How can it be nothing! I have disinfectant wipes here, come over. ...The wound isn't big but it's deep. Looks like... there's traces of arts damage too.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 诗怀雅看到星熊脸上的伤（陈打的）后立刻紧张询问，并拿出消毒湿巾要帮星熊处理。她对战友受伤的关心是真实的——联系上下文，这'害怕她'的担忧也包含着害怕失去陈的心情。
context_analysis.en_US: Swire panics seeing Hoshiguma's face injury (from Ch'en) and immediately offers disinfectant wipes. Her concern for the wounded is genuine — this fear of 'losing' Ch'en runs deeper than rivalry.

quote.zh_CN: 我说啊，老陈这个人，心口不一。她可是龙门的陈。就算她嘴上这么说，但她的梦想，她的目标，她的一生，都在这里。
quote.en_US: Look, old Chen here — she's all talk and no action, two-faced. But she's Lungmen's Chen. Even if she says these things, her dreams, her goals, her whole life — it's all here.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 星熊评价陈'心口不一'——嘴上说着强硬的话，心里却装着龙门和身边的人。这是理解陈的关键：她不是真的冷漠，而是表达方式刚硬。这是诗怀雅和星熊都理解的默契。
context_analysis.en_US: Hoshiguma says Ch'en is 'all talk' but has her heart in Lungmen. Key insight: Ch'en isn't truly cold, just expresses herself harshly. This is the shared understanding between Swire and Hoshiguma.

quote.zh_CN: 我怎么能担那个能力？我又不是她......
quote.en_US: How could I possibly have that ability? I'm not her...

context_analysis.zh_CN: 诗怀雅向星熊坦白她觉得自己'不适合近卫局'，因为她不是陈——她羡慕陈的魄力和能力，却不认为自己能做到。这说明在诗怀雅心中陈是近卫局的标杆和偶像般的存在。
context_analysis.en_US: Swire admits to Hoshiguma she feels 'unsuited for the Guard Bureau' because she's not Ch'en — envying Ch'en's courage and capability. Ch'en is Swire's benchmark and idol in her heart.

quote.zh_CN: 龙门失守了，整个近卫局都被整合运动控制着，这是你的错。当龙门需要你的时候，你为什么不在龙门？我替你感到羞耻，陈警司。
quote.en_US: Lungmen has fallen, the whole Guard Bureau is under Reunion control — this is YOUR fault. Why weren't you in Lungmen when it needed you? I'm ashamed of you, Inspector Ch'en.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 诗怀雅当众激烈指责陈，言辞尖锐。但联系level_st_07-03的回忆，这种'指责'背后是诗怀雅对陈'擅离职守'导致城市陷入危险的恐惧和愤怒——她不是真的恨陈，而是害怕失去她。
context_analysis.en_US: Swire publicly and harshly accuses Ch'en. But combined with level_st_07-03 memories, this 'accusation' masks Swire's terror at losing Ch'en — not genuine hatred, but fear disguised as anger.

quote.zh_CN: 命最重要。不要为了眼前事把命搭上，你还有很多人可以依靠。
quote.en_US: Life matters most. Don't risk your life for immediate concerns — you have many people you can rely on.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 诗怀雅在陈即将独自上天台对决梅菲斯特前真诚地叮嘱她安全第一。这不是政敌的嘲讽，而是真心的关心。
context_analysis.en_US: Swire genuinely tells Chen to prioritize her life before facing Mephisto alone. This is not rivalry taunt but sincere care.

quote.zh_CN: 靓饮茶餐厅——还记得吗？那家三文治里肉排很酥的那家。我请你。
quote.en_US: The Liangi Tea Restaurant — you remember? The one with the crispy pork chop sandwiches. My treat.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈主动提起与诗怀雅的共同回忆，并承诺请她吃三文治。这是陈罕见的主动缓和姿态，说明尽管嘴上争吵，她内心珍视与诗怀雅的友谊。
context_analysis.en_US: Chen proactively mentions their shared memory and promises to treat Swire. This is a rare conciliatory gesture from Chen.

quote.zh_CN: 想挨打的话，建议去整合运动后面排队。
quote.en_US: If you want to get beaten up, I suggest joining the back of the Reunion Movement line.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈对诗怀雅的挑衅回应以威胁式的玩笑话，语气虽强硬但实际是两人日常互怼模式，说明两人关系足够亲密。
context_analysis.en_US: Ch'en responds to Swire's provocation with threatening banter — their relationship is close enough for such joking.

description.zh_CN: 陈与梅菲斯特在近卫局天台展开生死对决，陈以赤霄斩击梅菲斯特及其护卫，最终梅菲斯特在浮士德帮助下逃离。
description.en_US: Ch'en and Mephisto battle on the Guard Bureau rooftop; Ch'en slashes Mephisto and his guards with Chi Xiao, but Mephisto escapes with Faust's help.

quote.zh_CN: 多说无益，齐上吧。这里不是整合运动该来的地方！
quote.en_US: Enough talk — come at me together. This is no place for Reunion!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈拒绝梅菲斯特的对话提议，宣示死战
context_analysis.en_US: Ch'en rejects Mephisto's dialogue offer, declaring total war

quote.zh_CN: 你也逃不掉。
quote.en_US: You won't escape either.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈用赤霄斩击浮士德，阻止梅菲斯特逃走
context_analysis.en_US: Ch'en uses Chi Xiao to slash Faust, preventing Mephisto's escape

evidences.quote: [近卫局成员] 别让他们走！击杀他们的指挥核心！
evidences.context_analysis: 近卫局的目标包括击杀梅菲斯特

evidences.quote: [陈] 不要放松警惕，这些感染者远比之前的整合运动敌人难缠。
evidences.context_analysis: 陈评价整合运动感染者的威胁

description.zh_CN: 星熊在陈与诗怀雅的冲突中扮演调解者角色，试图缓和两人的矛盾，并对诗怀雅保持礼貌。
description.en_US: Hoshiguma serves as mediator in Ch'en and Swire's conflicts, trying to defuse tension while remaining courteous to Swire.

quote.zh_CN: 嗨，抱歉，小姐。你们脾气其实都真够差的。不管她怎么说，刚才的援助还是谢谢你了。
quote.en_US: Hey, sorry about that, 'miss'. You two have quite the temper. Thanks for the assist though, whatever she says.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 星熊在陈和诗怀雅争吵后向诗怀雅致歉并感谢援助，扮演调解角色
context_analysis.en_US: Hoshiguma apologizes to Swire after the Ch'en/Swire argument and thanks her for help, acting as mediator

description.zh_CN: 陈与煌在近卫局天台配合作战，共同击败梅菲斯特的护卫。煌亲眼目睹陈以赤霄一剑斩杀十余人，对陈的实力深感震惊。
description.en_US: Ch'en and Blaze fight together on the Guard Bureau rooftop against Mephisto's guards. Blaze witnesses Ch'en cut down over a dozen enemies with one Chi Xiao slash, deeply impressed.

quote.zh_CN: 他们要上了，姓陈的！
quote.en_US: They're coming, you Chen!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 煌与陈联手面对梅菲斯特的护卫
context_analysis.en_US: Blaze teams up with Ch'en against Mephisto's guards

quote.zh_CN: 你刚才是不是拔剑了？一剑？十几个这种东西？全灭？
quote.en_US: Did you just draw your sword? One slash? A dozen of them? All dead?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 煌对陈用赤霄一剑斩杀十余人护卫表示震惊
context_analysis.en_US: Blaze is shocked by Ch'en slaying a dozen guards with one Chi Xiao slash

description.zh_CN: 陈是龙门近卫局长官魏彦吾的直接下属。魏彦吾制止陈对罗德岛的过激言论，陈服从命令。魏彦吾指定陈全权负责与罗德岛的对接。陈称魏彦吾为'魏长官'，忠诚执行命令。
description.en_US: Ch'en is the direct subordinate of Lungmen Guard Captain Wei Yenwu. Wei stops Ch'en's rampage against Rhodes Island; Ch'en obeys. Wei assigns Ch'en full authority over Rhodes Island coordination.

quote.zh_CN: 冷静些，陈警官，他们是客人。——我的客人。
quote.en_US: Calm down, Officer Ch'en. They are guests — my guests.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 魏彦吾制止陈对罗德岛的过激言论，陈服从命令
context_analysis.en_US: Wei stops Ch'en's outburst; Ch'en obeys

quote.zh_CN: 陈警官将全权负责和你们的对接事宜。
quote.en_US: Officer Ch'en will have full authority over your coordination.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 魏彦吾指定陈全权负责与罗德岛的对接
context_analysis.en_US: Wei assigns Ch'en as the liaison to Rhodes Island

quote.zh_CN: ......是。在他们违反龙门法律之前，我会容忍，长官。
quote.en_US: ...Yes. I will tolerate them — until they violate Lungmen law, sir.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈服从魏彦吾的命令，承认龙门法律底线
context_analysis.en_US: Ch'en obeys Wei's authority, acknowledging the legal boundary

evidences.quote: 魏彦吾：你们已经就位了？魏彦吾：对，没错。我知道。只是，近卫局有他们该做的事，你们有你们该做的。
evidences.context_analysis: 魏彦吾确认近卫局的部署，显示出对行动的整体指挥权

description.zh_CN: 陈与凯尔希在龙门会议室激烈交锋。陈质疑罗德岛、反对感染者参与龙门机密。凯尔希反击陈的立场，魏彦吾介入阻止冲突升级。陈言辞激烈但最终服从上级安排。
description.en_US: Ch'en and Kal'tsit clash fiercely in the Lungmen conference room. Ch'en questions Rhodes Island and opposes infected involvement in Lungmen affairs. Kal'tsit counters Ch'en's position; Wei intervenes to prevent escalation.

quote.zh_CN: 龙门目前没有将相关机密行动的方针通知罗德岛的义务。
quote.en_US: Lungmen currently has no obligation to inform Rhodes Island of classified operational plans.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈坚持龙门保密原则，与凯尔希针锋相对
context_analysis.en_US: Ch'en insists on Lungmen secrecy, directly opposing Kal'tsit

quote.zh_CN: 如果陈小姐认为龙门的安危，尚不如对感染者进行盲目的惩罚来得重要。
quote.en_US: If Miss Ch'en believes Lungmen's safety is less important than blindly punishing the infected.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希反驳陈的立场，表达强烈不认同
context_analysis.en_US: Kal'tsit rebuts Ch'en's stance with strong disagreement

description.zh_CN: 煌与陈在龙门战役中并肩作战。煌联手对抗梅菲斯特护卫，震惊于陈的赤霄斩击。煌评价陈是值得尊敬的战士。
description.en_US: Blaze and Ch'en fight side by side during the Lungmen campaign. Blaze teams up against Mephisto's guards, amazed by Ch'en's Chi Xiao slash. Blaze respects Ch'en as a warrior.

quote.zh_CN: 混账白发小子！！他又干了什么！
quote.en_US: That damn white-haired kid!! What did he do now!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 煌与陈共同对抗梅菲斯特制造的局面
context_analysis.en_US: Blaze and Ch'en face Mephisto's creation together

evidences.quote: 陈：你还没有调查我合作伙伴的权限。
evidences.context_analysis: 陈公开承认煌为合作伙伴，在监察司面前维护煌

evidences.quote: 陈：煌，收手吧，这三位贵人不是你我该伺候的。
evidences.context_analysis: 陈提醒煌注意局势，共同应对危机

evidences.quote: 煌：刚才谢谢你了。没别的。
evidences.context_analysis: 煌向陈表达感谢，显示双方建立默契

description.zh_CN: 煌与霜星在战场上相遇。煌震惊于霜星身上渗透出的源石结晶，共情于霜星的痛苦。煌称霜星为'白兔子'，感叹她'难道感觉不到疼吗'。霜星临终时，煌试图让阿米娅去救她。
description.en_US: Blaze encounters FrostNova on the battlefield. Blaze is shocked by the Originium crystals渗透ing from FrostNova's skin, feeling deep empathy. Blaze calls her 'white rabbit' and asks if she feels no pain. At FrostNova's death, Blaze urges Amiya to save her.

quote.zh_CN: 她不疼吗！她难道感觉不到疼吗！！
quote.en_US: Does she not feel pain?! Does she feel no pain!!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 煌震惊于霜星身上渗透出的源石结晶，产生强烈共情
context_analysis.en_US: Blaze is shocked by FrostNova's Originium seepage, feeling intense empathy

quote.zh_CN: 赢得漂亮，罗德岛。
quote.en_US: Well fought, Rhodes Island.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 霜星临终前向煌说'赢得漂亮'，展现战士间的相互认可
context_analysis.en_US: FrostNova acknowledges Blaze at death: 'Well fought'

evidences.quote: 我想试试用我的温度和你的温度打一次
evidences.context_analysis: 煌主动挑战霜星，双方使用冷热法术对决

evidences.quote: 我劝你一句。别再战斗了，白毛兔子。再这么强撑着用法术，你会死得很快。
evidences.context_analysis: 战斗后煌发现霜星身体状况恶化，警告她过度使用法术会导致死亡

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅与霜星在战场上相互认可。霜星临终前将最后一点生命交给阿米娅，说'凭你的头脑，应该也考虑到这点了吧？'。阿米娅能感知霜星情感的倒灌。霜星说阿米娅'很像当时的塔露拉'。
description.en_US: Amiya and FrostNova recognize each other as warriors. At death, FrostNova entrusts her remaining life to Amiya, saying 'With your mind, you should understand.' Amiya can sense FrostNova's emotions flooding in. FrostNova says Amiya resembles young Talulah.

quote.zh_CN: 凭你的头脑，应该也考虑到这点了吧？
quote.en_US: With your intelligence, you should understand this too, right?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 霜星临终前将生命托付给阿米娅
context_analysis.en_US: FrostNova entrusts her life to Amiya at death

quote.zh_CN: 很像啊。和当时的塔露拉，很像。
quote.en_US: She resembles... the Talulah of that time. Very much so.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 霜星评价阿米娅很像当时的塔露拉
context_analysis.en_US: FrostNova compares Amiya to young Talulah

evidences.quote: 霜星：我们迟早会是敌人，小兔子。只是，现在还不是。
evidences.context_analysis: 霜星表明当前不是敌人但终将敌对，展现复杂关系

evidences.quote: 阿米娅：霜星小姐，他们经历过什么，我清清楚楚。
evidences.context_analysis: 阿米娅表达对雪怪小队经历的理解和同情

evidences.quote: 霜星：那就祈祷我们别再见面吧。
evidences.context_analysis: 霜星表达不愿与罗德岛为敌但立场对立

description.zh_CN: 浮士德与霜星同属整合运动。浮士德牺牲后，霜星评价'浮士德是个好战士'。
description.en_US: Faust and FrostNova were Reunion comrades. After Faust's sacrifice, FrostNova says 'Faust was a good warrior.'

quote.zh_CN: 浮士德是个好战士。
quote.en_US: Faust was a good warrior.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 霜星听闻浮士德牺牲后给予的评价
context_analysis.en_US: FrostNova's evaluation upon learning of Faust's sacrifice

evidences.quote: 浮士德：霜星一定会来支援我们。浮士德：霜星不会背叛。我们不是说好了，要自己去看到真相？
evidences.context_analysis: 浮士德坚信霜星会来支援，不会背叛

description.zh_CN: 煌与阿米娅是罗德岛同事，煌称呼阿米娅为「小兔子」，两人关系亲密，阿米娅委托煌保护博士
description.en_US: Blaze and Amiya are Rhodes Island colleagues. Blaze calls Amiya 'little bunny', they are close. Amiya entrusts Blaze to protect the Doctor

evidences.quote: 小兔子！！阿米娅：别一见面就把我抱起来啊！！煌：怎么会有这么软的脸蛋......怎么会！
evidences.context_analysis: 煌与阿米娅重逢时热情拥抱，展现亲近关系

evidences.quote: 我会联系煌，让她保护你。会合前这一小段时间，也麻烦你，照看一下煌。
evidences.context_analysis: 阿米娅委托博士照顾煌的心理状态，说明两人信任关系

description.zh_CN: 煌对灰喉说过的歧视感染者言论表示不满并警告她
description.en_US: Blaze is dissatisfied and warns GreyThroat about her discriminatory remarks against the infected

evidences.quote: 下次你再对我们感染者同胞说那种话，我会撕掉你半张脸。
evidences.context_analysis: 煌警告灰喉不要歧视感染者同胞，语气强硬

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅尝试引导灰喉理解感染者的处境，认为她需要机会认清自己
description.en_US: Amiya tries to guide GreyThroat to understand the situation of the infected, believing she needs a chance to recognize herself

evidences.quote: 她没理由用那时的事情去批评现在的你。灰喉：谁知道呢，我真的改变看法了吗？我自己也不知道。阿米娅：（她的情感里没有恶意。她只是需要机会认清自己。）
evidences.context_analysis: 阿米娅理解灰喉的困惑，认为她需要机会认清自己

description.zh_CN: 浮士德与灰喉在战场上相遇，两人都累了，浮士德对灰喉的幼稚想法有所批评，但最终没有互相射击
description.en_US: Faust and GreyThroat encounter each other on the battlefield. Both are exhausted. Faust criticizes GreyThroat's naive thoughts but ultimately does not shoot each other

evidences.quote: 浮士德：罗德岛怎么会有这样幼稚的人？灰喉：是的，我很幼稚。我只会按命令做事。
evidences.context_analysis: 浮士德批评灰喉幼稚，但语气中带有某种认可

evidences.quote: 灰喉：你很累了。只要是用弩的人，都能看出你的疲劳。弦绷得太紧，这样下去一定会断掉。
evidences.context_analysis: 灰喉理解浮士德的疲劳和压力，两人产生某种共鸣

evidences.quote: 你没有射击我，我也没有。下次不会了。如果你没射杀我，我就会射杀你。
evidences.context_analysis: 两人约定下次相遇时会互相射击，但这次互相放过

description.zh_CN: Rosmontis与Scout是罗德岛同事，Scout关心Rosmontis，称呼她为小猫

evidences.quote: Scout：你会见到的，小猫。
evidences.context_analysis: Scout安慰Rosmontis会见到博士，称呼她小猫

description.zh_CN: Rosmontis与Ace是罗德岛同事，Rosmontis提到Ace的胡子很硬
description.en_US: Rosmontis and Ace are Rhodes Island colleagues. Rosmontis mentions that Ace's beard is very hard

evidences.quote: Rosmontis：Ace，胡子很硬。
evidences.context_analysis: Rosmontis与Ace有亲近的互动，评价Ace的胡子

description.zh_CN: Ace培育灰喉数月，认为她绝对没有恶意，只是需要表达的机会
description.en_US: Ace has mentored GreyThroat for months, believing she absolutely has no malice, just needs an opportunity to express herself

evidences.quote: Ace：我清楚。但她可能真的只是很疑惑，她想要去问这个问题。我没资格要求干员立即明白我们的处境，而且，灰喉从没质疑过罗德岛的命令。
evidences.context_analysis: Ace为灰喉的行为辩护，认为她只是疑惑而非恶意

description.zh_CN: Ace与煌是罗德岛精英干员同事，Ace资历比煌老，被煌调侃
description.en_US: Ace and Blaze are Rhodes Island elite operator colleagues. Ace has more seniority than Blaze and is teased by her

evidences.quote: 谁叫Ace资历比我老呢。
evidences.context_analysis: 煌承认Ace资历比她老，语气中有调侃

description.zh_CN: 塔露拉对弑君者发号施令，利用她铲除异己
description.en_US: Talulah commands and exploits Stalker to eliminate her enemies

evidences.quote: [塔露拉] 剩下那个叛徒的位置，我已经知道了。她就在龙门，去刺杀她，去巩固你的名字，去让你的敌人感到恐怖。
evidences.context_analysis: 塔露拉命令弑君者去刺杀敌人，巩固势力

description.zh_CN: 霜星告诫弑君者注意真正的敌人，展现战友关怀
description.en_US: FrostNova advises Stalker to be mindful of the real enemy, showing comradeship

evidences.quote: [霜星] 杀完你的仇人，然后呢，你又该做什么？别忘了谁是真正的敌人。
evidences.context_analysis: 霜星提醒弑君者不要忘记真正的敌人是谁

description.zh_CN: 林雨霞是魏彦吾的女儿，她在贫民区执行任务时内心挣扎，提及父亲
description.en_US: Lin Yuxia is Wei Yanwu's daughter; she mentions her father while carrying out missions in the slums

evidences.quote: [林雨霞] 爸爸，如果当时的你是现在的我，你也会这么做的，对吧。
evidences.context_analysis: 林雨霞内心独白，提及父亲魏彦吾

evidences.quote: [诗怀雅] 这支队伍，你知道他们在贫民区里做什么？[林雨霞] 他们有好好帮你们消灭整合运动啊。
evidences.context_analysis: 林雨霞执行父亲的意志，维护龙门秩序

description.en_US: Lin Yuxia and Siege have serious disagreements over the slums issue; Siege opposes Lin Yuxia's methods

evidences.quote: [诗怀雅] 臭老鼠！你在干嘛！是不是你！
evidences.context_analysis: 诗怀雅怀疑林雨霞与贫民区事件有关

evidences.context_analysis: 林雨霞解释自己与近卫局的不同职责

evidences.quote: [诗怀雅] 你父亲的一切心血都在那里！
evidences.context_analysis: 诗怀雅强调林雨霞父亲的努力都在贫民区

description.en_US: Chen discovers Lin Yuxia's special forces operations in the slums, showing obvious hostile attitude

evidences.quote: [陈] 龙门的特殊力量私下出动了。这片区域内的所有居民都生死不明。
evidences.context_analysis: 陈意识到林雨霞的特殊部队在贫民区活动

evidences.quote: [陈] 别蒙我，你心里有底。至少你听过，你绝对知道。
evidences.context_analysis: 陈明确表示知道林雨霞与特殊部队有关

evidences.quote: [林雨霞] 黑蓑们被陈逼走了？
evidences.context_analysis: 林雨霞提到陈逼走黑蓑一事

description.zh_CN: 魏彦吾信任诗怀雅，让诗怀雅维护龙门秩序
description.en_US: Wei Yanwu trusts Siege to maintain order in Longmen

evidences.quote: [林雨霞] 魏彦吾想你们维护龙门的秩序，而我们去除那些龙门不需要的东西。
evidences.context_analysis: 林雨霞传达魏彦吾的意志，让近卫局维护秩序

description.en_US: Both FrostNova and Patriot taught Faust; Faust trusts FrostNova to take command of the troops

evidences.quote: [幻影弩手] 爱国者和霜星都教过他。他成了我们的队长。
evidences.context_analysis: 幻影弩手回忆浮士德的成长经历

evidences.quote: [浮士德] 我信任霜星。如果她来了，你们都能幸存。
evidences.context_analysis: 浮士德临终前信任霜星会照顾他的部队

description.zh_CN: 浮士德是幻影弩手们的队长，领导他们作战
description.en_US: Faust is the leader of the Phantom Crossbowmen, leading them in battle

evidences.context_analysis: 幻影弩手们关心浮士德的健康

evidences.context_analysis: 幻影弩手执行浮士德的遗愿

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅与诗怀雅在龙门战役中合作，双方互相认可
description.en_US: Amiya and Siege cooperate in the Longmen battle, showing mutual respect

evidences.quote: [诗怀雅] 哎，这只小兔子，好厉害啊。
evidences.context_analysis: 诗怀雅对阿米娅表示赞赏

evidences.quote: [阿米娅] 那是诗怀雅小姐的声音吗？
evidences.context_analysis: 阿米娅认出诗怀雅的声音

description.zh_CN: 煌与梅菲斯特敌对，煌要参与最后一战
description.en_US: Blaze and Mephisto are hostile; Blaze participates in the final battle

evidences.quote: [煌] 看来没法在这闲着了。走了，博士，这就是最后一战了！
evidences.context_analysis: 煌准备参与对抗梅菲斯特的战斗

evidences.quote: [煌] 果然，当时在天台上就该把那小子直接收了。
evidences.context_analysis: 煌后悔没有早点解决梅菲斯特

description.zh_CN: 灰喉遇到神秘人物（林雨霞？），对其保持警惕
description.en_US: GreyThroat encounters a mysterious figure (possibly Lin Yuxia?) and remains vigilant

evidences.quote: [？？？] 他是你的朋友吗？[灰喉] ......我不知道。你是谁？
evidences.context_analysis: 灰喉对这个神秘人物保持警惕

evidences.quote: [？？？] 和感染者做朋友是很危险的。
evidences.context_analysis: 神秘人物对灰喉与感染者的关系表示担忧

description.en_US: Frostleaf expresses respect for Faust, calling him a good warrior. Faust stayed outside the slums to allow other squads to retreat safely.

evidences.quote: 浮士德他为了让我们和其他小队顺利撤退，留在了贫民区之外。那种情况下，很难生还。浮士德是个好战士。
evidences.context_analysis: 霜星对浮士德的牺牲表示敬意

description.zh_CN: 九（原近卫局成员）三年前已脱离近卫局，她认为原本应该是她命令陈。陈试图说服九回来帮助龙门
description.en_US: Nine (a former Guard Bureau member) left the Guard Bureau three years ago. She believes she should have been the one giving orders to Chen. Chen tries to convince Nine to help Lungmen.

description.en_US: The Assassin believes Kal'tsit betrayed the scientists' institute. Kal'tsit tries to explain the truth, revealing the real traitor was the Ursus empire.

evidences.context_analysis: 凯尔希解释她与弑君者父亲伊利亚的关系

evidences.quote: 凯尔希：一个人能活多少年岁，又能走过多少路？我们被蒙蔽的时间，总比我们看清事实的时候更多。
evidences.context_analysis: 凯尔希试图让弑君者认清真相

description.en_US: Red is Kal'tsit's subordinate, assisting her in capturing the Assassin. Red has excellent scent-tracking abilities.

evidences.context_analysis: 红通过嗅觉追踪弑君者

evidences.context_analysis: 红与凯尔希讨论如何处置弑君者

description.zh_CN: Mon3tr是凯尔希的使徒，与她共同行动，帮助她制服弑君者
description.en_US: Mon3tr is Kal'tsit's apostle, acting together with her to subdue the Assassin.

evidences.context_analysis: 凯尔希召唤Mon3tr协助作战

evidences.quote: Mon3tr：（欢快的嘶鸣）
evidences.context_analysis: Mon3tr响应凯尔希的召唤

description.zh_CN: 大熊是雪怪小队的成员，与霜星并肩作战
description.en_US: Big Bear is a member of the Snow Squad, fighting alongside Frostleaf.

evidences.context_analysis: 大熊参与雪怪小队的战斗

evidences.quote: 雪怪小队成员：......啊？*乌萨斯粗口*！大熊说他也没问题。
evidences.context_analysis: 大熊同意与罗德岛休战

description.zh_CN: 陨星是罗德岛干员，与霜星在战场上达成临时休战，共同抵抗黑色雨披特殊部队
description.en_US: Meteor is a Rhodes Island operator who achieved a temporary ceasefire with Frostleaf on the battlefield to jointly resist the black-raincoat special forces.

evidences.quote: 雪怪小队成员：......啊？*乌萨斯粗口*！大熊说他也没问题。
evidences.context_analysis: 雪怪小队同意休战

evidences.quote: 阿米娅：是。感染者本来不该相互为敌的。很抱歉。
evidences.context_analysis: 阿米娅承认杀害碎骨（亚历克斯），双方达成休战

description.zh_CN: 浮士德是梅菲斯特的下属和战友，梅菲斯特的精神受到创伤，浮士德为掩护他人撤退而留下
description.en_US: Faust is Mephisto's subordinate and comrade. Mephisto's spirit was traumatized, and Faust stayed behind to cover others' retreat.

evidences.quote: 霜星：梅菲斯特怎么在你们这？他怎么了？幻影弩手：梅菲斯特他似乎......精神受到了一点创伤。
evidences.context_analysis: 幻影弩手报告梅菲斯特的状况

evidences.quote: 霜星：浮士德呢？幻影弩手：浮士德他为了让我们和其他小队顺利撤退，留在了贫民区之外。
evidences.context_analysis: 浮士德为掩护他人牺牲自己

description.zh_CN: 杰西卡是罗德岛干员，与煌共同作战
description.en_US: Jessica is a Rhodes Island operator fighting alongside Blaze.

evidences.quote: 阿米娅：杰西卡，雪怪小队的动向呢？杰西卡：正，正在向我们的位置靠近！还有五百米左右！
evidences.context_analysis: 杰西卡负责侦察任务

description.zh_CN: 霜叶是罗德岛干员，与煌并肩作战，对雪怪小队有一定了解
description.en_US: Frostleaf is a Rhodes Island operator fighting alongside Blaze. She has some knowledge of the Snow Squad.

evidences.context_analysis: 霜叶身体状况不佳但坚持作战

evidences.context_analysis: 霜叶对雪怪小队的人性感到意外

description.en_US: Kal'tsit observed Blaze's interaction with the Snowcap Squad, commenting on Blaze's emotional state

evidences.quote: 凯尔希：你们的情感状态有些起伏不定。看来在切城废城，你们和这支整合运动的小队有过更深层次的交流。
evidences.context_analysis: 凯尔希观察并评论煌的情感状态，暗示对煌与雪怪小队关系的了解

description.zh_CN: 陨星作为罗德岛干员，配合阿米娅进行救援行动
description.en_US: FallingStar, as a Rhodes Island operator, cooperated with Amiya in rescue operations

evidences.context_analysis: 陨星评价阿米娅在博士安危面前的执着态度

evidences.quote: 霜星：治疗冻伤的特效药。独家秘方。至少能缓解烧灼感和疼痛。我研究这东西很久了，刚才那一仗，你打的很不错。
evidences.context_analysis: 霜星认可霜叶的战斗表现并给予奖励，展现雪怪小队内部温情
霜叶接受霜星的心意，展现小队团结

description.zh_CN: 煌对未能救下Ace感到遗憾和后悔，展现战友之情

evidences.quote: 煌：必须。
evidences.context_analysis: 煌确认对失去Ace的遗憾，必须为其复仇

evidences.quote: 煌：当然！没机会救下他，后悔吗？
